subtitle: Java Back-end Engineer / AI Full-Stack Application Developer
headline:
Built on Java back-end development with hands-on AI full-stack application experience.
Worked on knowledge base systems, e-commerce tools and automation workflows from development to deployment.

homeHero.description: Focused on Python and web architecture, exploring development paradigms in the AI era, and enjoying the process of building pure projects.

descriptionParts.suffix: , and enjoying the process of building pure projects.

bioMarkdown:
Hi, I'm Chen Yong Guan, a developer focused on Java back-end engineering and AI application delivery. I am comfortable with Spring Boot, MyBatis-Plus, MySQL and related back-end technologies, and I can also build AI-powered tools and web applications with Python and modern web stacks.

During my internships, I worked on an AI knowledge base for an education platform, a multi-tenant sticker e-commerce system, production automation tools, OCR quality inspection and deployment workflows. These experiences helped me build practical understanding across business systems, AI integration, data storage, SEO and shipping real products.

I am especially interested in Prompt design, Agent workflows and AI application architecture, and I want to keep growing into an engineer who can own business modules independently and push ideas into production.
blogTagline: Notes on engineering, AI applications and the things I learn while building.
